data.gender_notes: Gilchrist is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gilchrist is recorded in name-lists as “Pledge of Christ”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gilchrist expresses “Pledge of Christ”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gilchrist total 51, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: גִילחריסת
in_hebrew.meaning: God is my pledge, my reward
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Gilchrist is derived from the Hebrew words 'gil' (reward, pledge) and 'christ' (anointed one, Messiah). Together, the name means 'God is my pledge, my reward', reflecting the belief in a divine guarantee for those who follow God.

in_greek.name: Γελχριστος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Gilchrist is derived from the Greek words 'gelos' (reward) and 'christos' (anointed one). The name means 'Reward of God', emphasizing the idea of divine favor and blessings.

in_latin.name: Gilchristus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Gilchrist is derived from the Latin words 'gil' (reward) and 'christus' (anointed one). The name means 'Reward of Christ', reflecting the belief in the ultimate reward that comes from following and being anointed by Christ.
